caption: An arc welder is struck behind a screen in a garage, and the arc lights the whole garage in blue-white, throwing hard shadows.

sa.check: A garage interior with a welding screen.
An arc is struck behind the screen: a bright light appears there.
The arc lights the whole garage in blue-white.
Hard shadows are thrown across the garage.
The light comes from behind the screen, not from a lamp.

pc.expect: While the arc burns, the garage is lit from the arc's position: surfaces facing the screen are brightest, and the shadows of tools, benches and the screen itself stretch away from the arc with sharp edges.
pc.fail: The garage brightens evenly with no shadows; or the shadows point toward the arc; or the light comes from a place other than behind the screen; or the arc is visible but the garage stays lit only as before.

pc.expect: The intense light appears only while the arc is struck, flickers with it, and the garage returns to its earlier lighting when the arc stops.
pc.fail: The garage stays lit blue-white after the arc has gone out; or the light fades in slowly like a dimmer; or the light stays perfectly steady with no flicker while the arc burns; or the garage darkens below its earlier level when the arc stops.

pc.expect: The screen, benches and tools stay put as the arc comes and goes; only the light changes.
pc.fail: Tools or benches shift at the arc's start; or the screen falls or slides by itself; or objects jump between lit and unlit frames.

pc.expect: Any sparks that fly from behind the screen fall and go dark within a short distance.
pc.fail: Sparks rise and gather above the screen; or hang in the air; or lie glowing on the floor for the rest of the clip.
pc.precondition: Sparks are visible beyond the screen.

pc.expect: The garage's contents are the same in lit and unlit frames; the screen stays one screen in one place.
pc.fail: Tools, benches or vehicles appear or vanish between lit and unlit frames; or the screen duplicates or vanishes; or the arc light passes through the screen and shows the welder as if the screen were glass; or the garage's layout changes.

pc.expect: Wall colours, tool colours and the screen's colour are consistent apart from the arc's blue-white cast.
pc.fail: The walls change colour permanently after the arc; or tools change colour; or the screen changes colour or pattern.

note: The welder behind the screen is not judged; whoever strikes the arc may be out of view.
